title: How GOP Works: Diagnostic, Roadmap, Implementation
description: GOP embeds senior operators in your team: a fixed-scope diagnostic, a sequenced roadmap with owners, then implementation against KPIs reviewed weekly.

nodes.name: How a GOP engagement works
nodes.description: Diagnostic, roadmap and implementation with embedded operators against agreed KPIs.

step.name: Diagnostic
step.text: Fixed-scope review over one to two weeks producing a scorecard, quantified gap and priorities.

step.name: Roadmap
step.text: Sequenced, costed plan with owners and dates against the target.

step.name: Implementation
step.text: Operators embedded in the client team execute against agreed KPIs with a weekly review and handover of a working system.
